definitions.explanation: Trousers that end above the knee. Traditionally associated with children's clothing in Japan, though now worn by adults as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半|はん}ズボン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{半|はん}ズボン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: The children are running around in shorts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体操服|たいそうふく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{紺|こん}→紺：03885_kon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半|はん}ズボンだった。
examples.english: The elementary school PE uniform was a white shirt and navy shorts.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) and ⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧ (trousers, from French 'jupon'). In Japan, {半|はん}ズボン traditionally referred specifically to above-the-knee shorts worn by children. For adult casual shorts, ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧ or ハーフ⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧ are now more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半|はん}ズボン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧ (to wear shorts)
- {半|はん}ズボン⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (wearing shorts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧: shorts — the modern, adult-oriented term
- ハーフ⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧: half pants — knee-length or slightly above, common adult term
